#include <iostream>
#include <sstream>
#include <string>
#include <cctype>

using namespace std;

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(0);
    
    string line;
    while (getline(cin, line)) {
        if (line.empty()) break;
        istringstream iss(line);
        int n;
        string s;
        iss >> n;
        getline(cin, s);
        if (s.empty()) break;
        // Remove leading spaces if any
        s = s.substr(s.find_first_not_of(' '));
        
        bool paren = false;
        bool start = true;
        int maxOut = 0;
        int curOut = 0;
        int inWords = 0;
        int i = 0;
        while (i < n) {
            char c = s[i++];
            switch (c) {
                case '(':
                    paren = true;
                    start = true;
                    curOut = 0;
                    break;
                case ')':
                    paren = false;
                    curOut = 0;
                    break;
                case '_':
                    if (paren) {
                        start = true;
                    } else {
                        curOut = 0;
                    }
                    break;
                default:
                    if (paren) {
                        if (start) {
                            inWords++;
                            start = false;
                        }
                    } else {
                        curOut++;
                        if (curOut > maxOut) {
                            maxOut = curOut;
                        }
                    }
                    break;
            }
        }
        cout << maxOut << " " << inWords << "\n";
    }
    cout.flush();
    return 0;
}
